channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Suriname 2027 (Paramaribo, Moengo, Frederiksdorp)
item.description: Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) with local partner organisations in Suriname · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 8,500 subsidy for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL. One residency position is awarded. No application fee.
